title: ScreenshotShare
description: A mod to upload your screenshots and share them with your friends.
body:
The **ScreenshotShareMod** is a lightweight Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that streamlines screenshot sharing. Upload images directly from the game and receive a shareable URL that can be sent to friends or posted online.

No more searching through screenshot folders or manually uploading files to image hosting services. Simply take a screenshot, upload it through the mod, and get a link ready to share in seconds. Whether you're showing off builds, reporting bugs, sharing achievements, or capturing memorable moments, Screenshot Share makes the process quick and convenient without leaving Minecraft.
